overview: Nova is a showcase website for an eco-friendly agricultural drone technology by Team KisanNova that uses sonic waves to disrupt insects and protect crops without chemicals, helping farmers achieve higher yields while preserving the environment.
features: Hero section with Nova/KisanNova branding and value proposition
How It Works section with sonic wave technology steps
Environmental impact metrics and yield improvement stats
Crop protection comparison vs traditional pesticide methods
Demo request and pricing consultation CTAs
Footer with navigation and contact info
